name.value: Best Western Plus Kelowna Hotel & Suites

description.value: The Best Western Plus Kelowna Hotel & Suites is a branded highway hotel on the main Highway 97 corridor, positioned as a base for exploring the Okanagan Valley's wineries, golf courses, and family activities. The property features the 97 Street Pub, an on-site restaurant and pub offering meals throughout the day. Its location on the primary north-south route through Kelowna makes it a convenient stop for touring cyclists moving through the region.
